Hi Karthik / Laura,

Thanks again for the demo last week — ClearHarbor is keen to pilot Redwood for our freight-ops assistant use case. Finance flagged two items before we can issue a PO: our AP team prefers Net45 for new vendor pilots, and because we operate across EU entities we need clarity on VAT handling (which entity will be invoiced / whether VAT is charged or passed back).

From our side we can do a Net45 pilot if Redwood can accept a conditional retainer (we typically put 15% on new vendors) and split invoices across entities so VAT can be applied correctly. Can you confirm:
- Whether Redwood can accept a 15% retainer and Net45 for the pilot period
- If Redwood can split invoicing to our UK entity for services (we will supply VAT reg. if needed)
- Any minimum credit line or onboarding deposit Redwood requires to start ramping usage

I attached our VAT registration cert in a follow-up to speed review. If this aligns, Procurement will send the PO and sign the MSA.

Thanks,
Anna Li

Hi Anna — thanks for the clear ask. Short answer: yes, we can structure a short Net45 pilot with split invoicing, but we typically require a modest onboarding deposit or a staged remittance ladder to mitigate credit risk for new accounts.

Proposed approach:
- Pilot length: 90 days
- Payment plan: 15% retainer upon PO (as you suggested) + two milestone invoices during pilot (40% at onboarding completion, remaining 45% distributed over two Net45 invoices)
- Credit cap: initial line of $250,000 for pilot; we can review after 60 days and consider increasing based on consumption and on-time payment cadence
- VAT: we can issue invoices to your UK entity and apply VAT according to the VAT cert you provide — we'd need the VAT registration number and the invoicing entity details to prepare correct tax invoices

If this looks workable I will circulate a one-page remittance ladder (xlsx) that finance can attach to the PO and we'll include the payment plan in the MSA appendix. Please confirm the billing entity name and VAT ID and I'll loop in Marcus (payments) to set up the billing profile.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Anna — appreciate the context. Two small additions from finance:

1) Early-pay incentive: if ClearHarbor can do Net30 for the first two invoices, we can provide a 1.5% credit on the invoice total (applied as a credit on the following invoice).
2) If retaining the 15% retainer, Redwood can reduce the onboarding deposit to 10% provided the PO references the remittance ladder and the MSA appendix (this is standard for pilots >$100k).

Attachment plan: Karthik will send v1 of the remittance ladder; Marcus will prepare the billing profile once we have the VAT ID and legal entity. For speed, please sign the MSA (we will send via DocuSign) and attach the PO with the remittance ladder reference.

DocuSign note: we use a lightweight MSA for pilots — it includes payment terms, data residency, and a 30-day escalation clause tied to billing disputes.
